description: This source file defines a PHP class 'File' that extends another class 'Response'. It manages backup files within a CRM system, providing functionalities such as constructing file paths, fixing path separators, starting and finishing backups, and writing data to backup files.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class for managing database backup files, including determining file paths, handling path separators, and controlling backup file write operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the File object, setting default paths and file paths based on constructor parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultFolderPath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the default folder path for backups based on configuration.

methods.name: fixPathSeparator
methods.description: Ensures that the file path uses the correct DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, replacing '/' with the proper separator.

methods.name: getDefaultFilePath
methods.description: Generates a default filename with a timestamp and proper folder path.

methods.name: startBackup
methods.description: Opens the backup file for writing and initiates backup process.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to the backup file.

methods.name: finishBackup
methods.description: Completes the backup process and closes the file handle.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the current backup file path.
